verdict.rationale: Docs confirm workspace-level hard budgets with daily/weekly/monthly/lifetime caps that auto-block requests, and a key-management API supporting per-key limits, corroborated by community reports of 'billing caps' and 'expiry/limits per key'. However, there's no explicit evidence of per-user budget controls distinct from workspace/team, so coverage of the full persona/team/user granularity is incomplete.
